name: TENDA Co.,LTD.
summary: TENDA Co., Ltd. operates a DX solutions business in Japan through DX Solution, Techwise Consulting, Game Content and Other segments. Products include Dojo, software that automatically creates manuals, Dojo Web Manual, Dojo Navi for system operation navigation, TEnWA, a business chat service, and GAKTE, an e-learning system. It also offers Microsoft product services, Web3 consulting, system operation and AI solutions.
